**My pick: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K).** It's the best balance of slim, fast and well reviewed for an iPhone 17.

## Top picks

**Best overall slim: Anker Nano Power Bank 5K, $54.99**
- It's 0.34" thick and weighs 4.3 oz (122 g), with 15W Qi2 wireless charging and 20W wired.
- 9to5Mac's reviewer has used it and calls it the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery.
- Anker's page lists the iPhone 17 series as compatible at 15W max.
- [Buy at Anker US](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)

**Thinnest and lightest: Baseus Picogo Air AM71 (5K), about $53-70**
- It's 0.27" thick and 104 g. Android Central calls it the thinnest and lightest of the slim Qi2 banks it tested.
- The catch is that its wireless speed is listed at only 7.5W, so it's slower than the Anker.
- Android Central shows $52.99 at Amazon, and I don't have a direct product link. The [Android Central roundup](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge) has the buy buttons.

**Slim with more capacity and fast charging: INIU SnapGo Air (10K, 25W Qi2.2), about $43-49**
- It's 0.5" thick and 195 g, with 25W wireless, which the iPhone 17 supports, plus 45W wired.
- It includes a built-in lanyard-style USB-C cable.
- Macworld lists it as tied for the slimmest 10K power bank it tested.
- Android Central shows $42.99 at Amazon, and I don't have a direct product link. See the [Android Central roundup](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge) for buy links.

**Another 10K, 25W option: Baseus PicoGo AM52, $59.99 ($53.99 with code AM52)**
- It has 25W Qi2.2 wireless on iPhone 16 and 17, and 45W wired.
- No thickness is listed, so I can't confirm it's slim.
- The code was tested by the listing site on Oct 24, but checkout has the final word. This is an affiliate link, so the site earns a commission at no cost to you.
- [Buy at Baseus via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w)

## How to choose
- **Pocketability first:** get a 5K bank like the Anker Nano. Macworld says 5K packs usually recharge a phone about 60-75%.
- **Capacity and speed:** get a 10K bank with 25W. Macworld says 10K can charge a phone close to twice.
- Only iPhone 16 and later get 25W, which includes your iPhone 17.
- Thick or non-magnetic cases can weaken the connection. Anker says cases over 2.5 mm may interfere.

Sources: [Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank), [Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge), [Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html), [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/), [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w)
